title: Concept: Vendored dependencies shipped inside the package
description: package.json declares a `bundledDependencies` list that ships copies of packages, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `bundledDependencies` list that ships copies of packages.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `bundledDependencies` list that ships copies of packages.
